panel.title: Alerts
panel.description: FLOX checks these rules every few minutes and notifies you once per day (per offer, per certificate) when one trips. Spend and ROI are for today in the organization's timezone.
panel.slackNotConnected: Slack is not connected — connect it on the Integrations tab to send alerts there.

kindHints.spend_over: Today's spend on a campaign goes over the amount.
kindHints.roi_below: Today's ROI of a campaign drops below the percentage. Needs spend on file — no cost, no ROI.
kindHints.offer_capped: An offer reaches its daily conversion cap and leaves the flow draw until midnight.
kindHints.offer_paused: Someone sets an offer to paused; traffic of the flows that use it goes to the stream set's or campaign's fallback.
kindHints.ssl_expiring: A domain's certificate expires within the number of days, or has expired.

delete.title: Delete this alert?
delete.description: "{{name}}" stops notifying. Notifications it already sent stay.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing yet. Alerts you set up in Settings → Alerts show here.

offer_capped.title: Offer daily cap reached
offer_capped.body: {{offer}}: {{used}} of {{cap}} conversions — no traffic until midnight.

offer_paused.title: Offer paused
offer_paused.body: {{offer}} was paused; traffic of its flows goes to the fallback URL.

ssl_expired.title: SSL certificate expired
ssl_expired.body: {{domain}}: the certificate has expired — tracking links on it fail in browsers.
